The plate is a square white one, probably about 24 cm across. On it are an arugula salad and a few cauliflower florets.

The arugula is a modest pile, roughly 40 g. With a little dressing and a few bits that look like nuts or bacon, it comes to about 60 kcal.

The cauliflower looks steamed or boiled. It is about 4 florets, around 100 g, which is roughly 25-30 kcal.

Together that is about 150 g of food. The dressing and the toppings add a bit more, so I'll put the total at about 90 kcal.
